summary: Tennessee Valley Authority filed an 8‑K to disclose entry into a $1 billion revolving credit facility (Third Amended and Restated July Maturity Credit Agreement), refinancing an existing 2022 facility. The credit line matures July 10, 2031, with variable interest tied to TVA’s senior unsecured debt rating. Agent is Toronto Dominion (Texas) LLC; lenders include Bank of America, CIBC, Morgan Stanley, BNY Mellon, and U.S. Bank. Unused commitment fees and letter‑of‑credit fees also depend on TVA’s credit rating. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or structural change is involved.
